honours.title: Sir Garfield Sobers Trophy
honours.subtitle: ICC Men's Cricketer of the Year

honours.title: ICC Men's Test Cricketer of the Year
ICC Men's Test Team of the Year
honours.note: Named captain of the side in 2004, 2005 and 2007.

honours.title: ICC Men's ODI Team of the Year
honours.note: Named captain of the side in 2004, 2007, 2008 and 2010.

honours.title: Sport Australia Hall of Fame
honours.note: Inductee. The year is not recorded here because it was not confirmed against a source.

honours.title: Allan Border Medal
honours.subtitle: Australian cricketer of the year
honours.note: A record four medals. The 2009 medal was shared with Michael Clarke.

honours.title: Wisden Leading Cricketer in the World
Wisden Cricketer of the Year
honours.note: One of the five named in the 2006 almanack.

honours.title: Player of the Decade
honours.subtitle: ESPNcricinfo, 2000 to 2009
honours.note: Voted Player of the Decade, announced in January 2010.

honours.title: Officer of the Order of Australia
honours.subtitle: AO
honours.note: Appointed on Australia Day 2012 for services to cricket and, through the Ponting Foundation, the community.

honours.title: Compton–Miller Medal
honours.subtitle: Ashes player of the series
honours.note: Awarded for the home Ashes that Australia won without losing a Test.

honours.title: Sheffield Shield Player of the Year
honours.note: In his last season for Tasmania.

honours.title: Highest Test score in a losing cause
honours.subtitle: Against India, Adelaide, December 2003
honours.note: No batter has made more in a Test his side went on to lose.

honours.title: ODI hundreds against every Test nation
honours.subtitle: First batter to do it
honours.note: Counts the Test-playing nations of his era. Afghanistan and Ireland were given Test status after he retired.

honours.title: Highest partnership in the Champions Trophy
honours.subtitle: With Shane Watson, second wicket, against England at Centurion
honours.note: Unbroken stand on 2 October 2009. Still the tournament record for any wicket.
